---
title: "Prototype — interactive demand"
subtitle: "Two sliders, one point: along the curve, and shifts of the curve"
format:
  html:
    css: [base.css, custom_itwd.css]
---

Move the first slider and the dot slides **along** a curve that never moves. Move the second and the whole curve **shifts**, because everything other than price lives in the intercept.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof price = Inputs.range([0, 1200], {value: 500, step: 10, label: "Price"})
viewof size  = Inputs.range([1200, 3200], {value: 2500, step: 50, label: "Market size"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
b = 2
BASE = 2500
Qof = (p, a) => Math.max(0, a - b * p)
Qnow = Qof(price, size)
grid = d3.range(0, 1251, 5)
curve = grid.map(p => ({p, q: Qof(p, size)}))
ghost = grid.map(p => ({p, q: Qof(p, BASE)}))
shifted = Math.abs(size - BASE) > 1

Plot.plot({
  width: 720,
  height: 420,
  marginLeft: 62,
  marginBottom: 46,
  style: {background: "transparent", fontSize: "13px", color: "#4A5751"},
  x: {domain: [0, 1250], label: "Price →", tickFormat: d => `$${d3.format(",")(d)}`,
      labelAnchor: "right"},
  y: {domain: [0, 3400], label: "↑ Quantity", tickFormat: d3.format(","),
      grid: true, labelAnchor: "top"},
  marks: [
    // reference curve, only once it has been moved off
    shifted ? Plot.line(ghost, {x: "p", y: "q", stroke: "#9CA8A2",
                                strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeDasharray: "4,4"}) : null,
    // the demand curve
    Plot.line(curve, {x: "p", y: "q", stroke: "#2563EB", strokeWidth: 2.5}),
    // read-off guides
    Plot.ruleX([price], {y1: 0, y2: Qnow, stroke: "#77837D", strokeDasharray: "2,3"}),
    Plot.ruleY([Qnow], {x1: 0, x2: price, stroke: "#77837D", strokeDasharray: "2,3"}),
    // the point, ringed in surface so it reads over the line
    Plot.dot([{p: price, q: Qnow}], {x: "p", y: "q", r: 6, fill: "#16201B",
                                     stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.text([{p: price, q: Qnow}], {
      x: "p", y: "q", dx: 12, dy: -14, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 13,
      fill: "#16201B", fontWeight: 600,
      text: d => `$${d3.format(",")(d.p)}, ${d3.format(",")(Math.round(d.q))} units`
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#CFD6D2"})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<p style="margin-top:.5rem;color:#4A5751">
At a price of <strong>$${d3.format(",")(price)}</strong>,
quantity is <strong>${d3.format(",")(Math.round(Qnow))}</strong> units.
${shifted
  ? `The dashed line is where the curve sat with ${d3.format(",")(BASE)} customers.`
  : `Move the second slider to see the curve shift.`}
</p>`
```
